confirmedFacts: Michael Penix Jr. is Atlanta's announced Thursday starter and was estimated full Monday.

Green Bay's Monday estimated report listed Jayden Reed DNP with a neck injury, Aaron Banks DNP with knee/toe injuries, Zach Bako-Bewele DNP with a knee injury, and Donovan Jennings DNP with a hand injury.
Atlanta's Monday estimate listed A.J. Terrell Jr. DNP with a groin injury and Brian Robinson Jr. limited with an ankle injury.
Jaxson Dart left Monday night with a left knee injury and did not return; X-rays were negative.
The Giants said an MRI would be performed Tuesday.
attributedReporting: NFL Network/Reuters reporting and John Harbaugh's postgame comments place the injury in the MCL-sprain neighborhood, but the official MRI result is not yet confirmed in team reporting at this checkpoint.
